headline: Three buses set on fire across Dhaka, security beefed up
summary: Two buses in Mirpur and one in Badda were torched, prompting authorities to increase security across the capital following crude bomb blasts.
details: Three buses were set on fire in different parts of Dhaka, including two in Mirpur and one in Badda. The incidents caused significant disruption and panic among commuters.
The arson attacks occurred alongside reports of crude bomb blasts in the city, leading to a tense atmosphere across the capital.
In response to the violence, security forces have been beefed up across Dhaka to prevent further incidents and maintain law and order.
Authorities are currently investigating the cause of the bus fires and the identity of those responsible for the arson and blasts.
caption:
Three buses torched and crude bomb blasts hit Dhaka. Security forces are now on high alert across the city.

Three buses were set on fire in different parts of Dhaka, including two in Mirpur and one in Badda. The incidents caused significant disruption and panic among commuters.

The arson attacks occurred alongside reports of crude bomb blasts in the city, leading to a tense atmosphere across the capital.

In response to the violence, security forces have been beefed up across Dhaka to prevent further incidents and maintain law and order.

Authorities are currently investigating the cause of the bus fires and the identity of those responsible for the arson and blasts.

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Prothom Alo

headline_marked: 3 suspects detained in [[13-year-old Apratim's murder]] in Comilla
headline: 3 suspects detained in 13-year-old Apratim's murder in Comilla
summary: The victim was the son of a Comilla University teacher. His body was found in a jungle area near the university campus.
details: Ishayat Shahriyar Apratim, a 7th-grade student of Comilla Border Guard School, was found dead in a jungle area behind Magic Paradise Park near Comilla University.
Apratim had gone out on Friday afternoon with his mother's iPhone to take photos with friends at Shalban Vihara.
After he failed to return home by evening, his mother, an associate professor at Comilla University, professor Nahida Begum, filed a general diary (GD) at the Comilla Sadar South Police Station.
Following a lead from CCTV footage, police have detained three suspects: Tuhin, Fahim, and Anas.
The autopsy was completed on Saturday, and the body was handed over to the family on Saturday night.
The first funeral prayer (janaza) will be held on Sunday morning at the university campus, followed by a second prayer at the the Gandhamati Eidgah field in Comilla.
University students have held protests demanding justice for the Apratim, while police officials have vowed to continue working non-stop until the actual killers are caught.
caption:
A 13-year-old boy, the son of a university professor, was found dead in a jungle. Three suspects are now in custody.

Ishayat Shahriyar Apratim, a 7th-grade student of Comilla Border Guard School, was found dead in a jungle area behind Magic Paradise Park near Comilla University.

Apratim had gone out on Friday afternoon with his mother's iPhone to take photos with friends at Shalban Vihara.

After he failed to return home by evening, his mother, an associate professor at Comilla University, professor Nahida Begum, filed a general diary (GD) at the Comilla Sadar South Police Station.

Following a lead from CCTV footage, police have detained three suspects: Tuhin, Fahim, and Anas.

The autopsy was completed on Saturday, and the body was handed over to the family on Saturday night.

The first funeral prayer (janaza) will be held on Sunday morning at the university campus, followed by a second prayer at the the Gandhamati Eidgah field in Comilla.

University students have held protests demanding justice for the Apratim, while police officials have vowed to continue working non-stop until the actual killers are caught.

#Comilla #JusticeForApratim #Bangladesh #CrimeNews #Justice

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Jamuna TV, Prothom Alo
